_comment: Thresholds sourced from spec section 3 unless marked CONFIRMED-IN-CHAT (values the spec left open, decided by the user on 2026-07-27).

sector_leadership._note: Breadth of fundamental improvement across each Industry. An EARLY SIGNAL of a re-rating already visible in the financials - never a prediction. Never folded into the P1-P7 core score or any tier.

screener._note: Screener.in rate-limits on a short rolling window. Unpaced, a 20-stock run gets HTTP 429 on everything after roughly the first eight. Raise min_request_interval_s if 429s still appear.

stage2._source_note: live = fetch from Screener.in with the stored login. local = read a previously-saved export from paths.fundamentals_dir. Live is the default at the user's direction; local remains the fallback when scraped selectors break.

stage1._ingestion_note: Manual Chartink CSV upload only. The scripted POST to /screener/process was removed at the user's direction.

market_cap._note: SEBI classifies by RANK (top 100 large, next 150 mid, rest small), not by an absolute figure. When the bulk sector reference export is loaded the true rank is used; the *_cr thresholds are the fallback and will disagree at the boundaries.

p8_peer_rank._note: P8 reports where a stock stands among sector and subsector peers on 1-year price return. Never scored - the bands only colour the badge; the exact rank is in the detail.

leaderboard._note: Sectors and subsectors ranked by MEDIAN 6-month share price return of their constituents. Median resists one multi-bagger carrying a flat sector. Groups below min_constituents are excluded rather than allowed to win on a handful of names.
leaderboard._refresh_note: Sector ranking is built from a quarterly bulk export, so it is prompted rather than scheduled. Being due never blocks - the last result stays on screen, marked stale.

history._note: Rolling window of screening runs kept on disk. Older runs are pruned on save.

p7_valuation._pegy_rule: CONFIRMED-IN-CHAT: absolute PEGY <= 1.0. Spec said 'sector-index PE-derived benchmark' but NSE publishes no sector EPS growth, so no true sector PEGY is computable.
p7_valuation._pb_band: CONFIRMED-IN-CHAT: <= 1.25x the NSE sector index PB.

tiers._comment: Percentage of ACTIVE maximum, never a fixed point total (spec section 4).

kite._credentials_note: Never stored in this repo. Read from Windows Credential Manager via keyring, or from environment variables. See spec section 9.
